<style id="mmd-friend-referral-v17">
@font-face{font-family:"Anuphan";font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab03af83c714e7ca09d4d5f_Anuphan-Regular.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"Anuphan";font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab03af8f8fd3acb9ca38e4d_Anuphan-Medium.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"Anuphan";font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab03af8bae381fe8af7b3fd_Anuphan-SemiBold.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"Anuphan";font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab03af8e6af8380eb7ade4f_Anuphan-Bold.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"General Sans";font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab03e0906124a74b5e2a114_GeneralSans-Regular.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"General Sans";font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab03e09393d9307034e1c53_GeneralSans-Medium.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"General Sans";font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab03e09ac36bac3c6685725_GeneralSans-Semibold.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"General Sans";font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab03e096209f014ff07c142_GeneralSans-Bold.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"Satoshi";font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab14912ae97f0a7a0fd93d9_Satoshi-Regular.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"Satoshi";font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab14912d1ba49f7fb7fcf56_Satoshi-Medium.ttf") format("truetype")}
@font-face{font-family:"Satoshi";font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6ab149126876bbe61da30a9c_Satoshi-Bold.ttf") format("truetype")}

#mmdFriendReferralNext{
  --bg:#0c0d0d;--panel:#111312;--panel-warm:#17130f;--ivory:#fff9f0;--copy:#ddd5cb;
  --muted:#b9b0a6;--gold:#d7af67;--gold-hi:#f5e2b5;--line:rgba(215,175,103,.28);
  --ink:#17120b;--wine:#2a0e13;--ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
  position:relative;isolation:isolate;width:100%;min-height:100vh;overflow-x:clip;background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--copy);font-family:"Anuphan",Tahoma,"Noto Sans Thai",sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.72;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;color-scheme:dark;padding-bottom:82px
}
#mmdFriendReferralNext *,#mmdFriendReferralNext *::before,#mmdFriendReferralNext *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
#mmdFriendReferralNext :where(h1,h2,h3,p,figure,ol,ul){margin:0}
#mmdFriendReferralNext :where(h1,h2,h3){font-family:"Anuphan",Tahoma,"Noto Sans Thai",sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-wrap:balance}
#mmdFriendReferralNext :where(a,button,input,select,textarea,summary){font:inherit}
#mmdFriendReferralNext a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
#mmdFriendReferralNext img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
#mmdFriendReferralNext :where(a,button,summary):focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-hi);outline-offset:5px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext :where(section[id],[id]){scroll-margin-top:136px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-wrap{width:min(100%,1344px);padding-inline:20px;margin-inline:auto}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-nav{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:90;min-height:72px;padding:12px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(12,13,13,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(22px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px)
}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-brand-mark{width:32px;height:36px;flex:0 0 32px;display:grid;place-items:center}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-brand-mark svg{display:block;width:26px;height:30px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-brand-name{display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:var(--ivory);font-family:"General Sans",Satoshi,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.12em}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-brand-name small{margin-top:4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.17em;font-weight:400}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-dashboard-link{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px;padding:0 13px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;color:var(--ivory);font-family:"General Sans",Satoshi,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;transition:border-color .25s,background .25s}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-dashboard-link:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(215,175,103,.08)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-reading-line{position:absolute;bottom:-1px;inset-inline:0;height:2px;pointer-events:none;transform:scaleX(var(--read-progress,0));transform-origin:left;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8c6838,var(--gold-hi));box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(215,175,103,.3)}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero{position:relative;min-height:760px;overflow:hidden;background:#0b0c0c;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-media{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:0}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:73% center;transform:scale(1.002)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:
  linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,9,9,.98) 0%,rgba(8,9,9,.93) 28%,rgba(8,9,9,.65) 48%,rgba(8,9,9,.12) 76%,rgba(8,9,9,.06) 100%),
  linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(8,9,9,.92) 0%,transparent 42%)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:760px;display:grid;align-content:end;padding-top:90px;padding-bottom:28px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-copy{max-width:620px;padding-bottom:34px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--gold-hi);font-family:"General Sans",Satoshi,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;line-height:1.5;text-transform:uppercase}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-kicker::before{content:"";display:block;flex:0 0 23px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-kicker-gold{color:var(--gold)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero h1{margin-top:22px;color:var(--ivory);font-size:clamp(36px,8.8vw,58px);line-height:1.28;letter-spacing:-.04em}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero h1 em,#mmdFriendReferralNext h2 em{display:block;color:var(--gold-hi);font-style:normal}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-lead{max-width:570px;margin-top:20px;color:var(--copy);font-size:15px;line-height:1.92}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px 22px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;min-height:52px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;padding:14px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:transform .35s var(--ease),box-shadow .35s,border-color .35s;overflow:hidden}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-btn-light{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#eddbb9,#d4b17c);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(208,173,119,.1)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;transform:translateX(-130%) skewX(-20deg);background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.22),transparent);pointer-events:none}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-btn:hover::after{animation:fr-sheen .8s var(--ease)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-text-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:48px;color:var(--ivory);font-size:13px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(215,175,103,.4)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-text-link span{transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-text-link:hover span{transform:translateY(3px)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-trust{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:22px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-trust span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:32px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(215,175,103,.22);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(10,11,11,.52);color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-trust span::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;margin-right:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold-hi)}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));border-top:1px solid rgba(215,175,103,.32);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(215,175,103,.16);background:rgba(9,10,10,.56);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta a{position:relative;display:block;min-width:0;padding:18px 12px 18px 0}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta a+a{padding-left:14px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta :where(span,b,small){display:block}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta span{color:var(--gold-hi);font-family:Satoshi,"General Sans",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta b{margin-top:7px;color:var(--ivory);font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta small{margin-top:4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.55}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-branch{position:sticky;top:72px;z-index:70;border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(12,13,13,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-branch-track{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 16px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#504532 #0c0d0d}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-branch a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;transition:background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-branch a.is-active{color:var(--gold-hi);background:rgba(215,175,103,.08);border-color:var(--line)}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section{position:relative;padding:66px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#0e1010}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section-dark{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 50%,rgba(118,75,35,.08),transparent 65%),#0b0c0c}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section-warm{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#141411,#1a1511 65%,#141311)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section-head{display:grid;gap:6px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section-head h2{margin-top:18px;color:var(--ivory);font-size:clamp(29px,7.2vw,44px);line-height:1.35;font-weight:500}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section-head>p{margin-top:18px;max-width:690px;color:var(--copy);font-size:15px;line-height:1.9}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-steps{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:30px;padding:0;list-style:none}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-steps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(215,175,103,.05),rgba(255,255,255,.015))}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-steps li>span,#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-care-grid article>span{color:var(--gold-hi);font-family:Satoshi,"General Sans",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-steps b,#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-care-grid b{display:block;color:var(--ivory);font-size:18px;font-weight:500}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-steps p,#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-care-grid p{margin-top:7px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.85}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-route-grid{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:30px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-route-grid article{position:relative;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-route-grid article.is-active{border-color:rgba(215,175,103,.5);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(215,175,103,.10),rgba(255,255,255,.015))}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-route-grid article>span{display:block;color:var(--gold-hi);font-family:"General Sans",Satoshi,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-route-grid h3{margin-top:12px;color:var(--ivory);font-size:20px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-route-grid p{margin-top:9px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.85}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-inline-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;margin-top:18px;color:var(--gold-hi);font-weight:600;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(215,175,103,.38)}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-care-grid{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:30px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-care-grid article{padding:22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-care-grid b{margin-top:12px}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-faq-wrap{max-width:980px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-faq{margin-top:30px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-faq summary{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:66px;padding:14px 42px 14px 0;color:var(--ivory);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-faq summary::after{content:"+";position:absolute;right:4px;color:var(--gold-hi);font-family:"General Sans",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:400}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-faq details[open] summary::after{content:"−"}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-faq details p{padding:0 36px 20px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.85}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-final{padding:72px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%,rgba(215,175,103,.14),transparent 36%),linear-gradient(135deg,#171512,#0c0d0d)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-final-inner{max-width:900px}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-final h2{margin-top:18px;color:var(--ivory);font-size:clamp(30px,7.4vw,48px);line-height:1.35;font-weight:500}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-final p:not(.fr-kicker){max-width:620px;margin-top:18px;color:var(--copy)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-final .fr-btn{margin-top:26px}

#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-footer{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:28px 20px 34px;color:var(--muted);font-family:"General Sans",Satoshi,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;background:#090a0a}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-mobile-cta{position:fixed;z-index:80;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:10px 12px max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(10,9,8,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-mobile-cta a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:50px;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#eddbb9,#d4b17c);color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;font-weight:600}

@keyframes fr-sheen{to{transform:translateX(130%) skewX(-20deg)}}

@media(min-width:768px){
  #mmdFriendReferralNext{padding-bottom:0}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-wrap{padding-inline:32px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero,#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-inner{min-height:760px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-inner{align-content:center;padding-top:86px;padding-bottom:42px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-copy{width:48%;max-width:650px;padding-bottom:0}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero h1{font-size:clamp(44px,4.8vw,72px);line-height:1.2}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-lead{font-size:16px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta{position:absolute;left:32px;right:32px;bottom:30px;width:min(720px,58%)}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section{padding:90px 0}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section-head{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(320px,.62fr);align-items:end;gap:40px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section-head>p{margin-top:0}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-steps,#mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-care-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-steps li{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:220px;align-content:start;padding:26px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-route-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-route-grid article{padding:30px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-footer{flex-direction:row;justify-content:space-between;padding:30px max(32px,calc((100vw - 1280px)/2))}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-mobile-cta{display:none}
}
@media(min-width:1200px){
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-shade{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,9,9,.99) 0%,rgba(8,9,9,.94) 30%,rgba(8,9,9,.56) 50%,rgba(8,9,9,.05) 78%,rgba(8,9,9,.02) 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(8,9,9,.55),transparent 42%)}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-media img{object-position:76% center}
}
@media(max-width:767px){
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-nav{min-height:64px;padding:10px 14px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-brand-name{font-size:10px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-brand-name small{font-size:7px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-dashboard-link{padding-inline:10px;font-size:9px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero{min-height:730px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-media img{object-position:72% center}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-shade{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,9,9,.06) 0%,rgba(8,9,9,.18) 28%,rgba(8,9,9,.88) 58%,rgba(8,9,9,.99) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,9,9,.82) 0%,rgba(8,9,9,.26) 65%,rgba(8,9,9,.08) 100%)}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-inner{min-height:730px;align-content:end;padding-top:280px;padding-bottom:18px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-copy{padding-bottom:22px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero h1{font-size:clamp(30px,8.8vw,40px);line-height:1.34}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-lead{font-size:15px;line-height:1.85}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-top:20px;gap:8px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-btn{width:100%}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-text-link{justify-content:center;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-trust{gap:6px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-trust span{font-size:11px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta a{padding:13px 0}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta a+a{padding-left:0;border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-hero-meta small{display:none}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-branch{top:64px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section{padding:50px 0}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section-head h2{font-size:clamp(26px,7.2vw,34px)}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-section-head>p{font-size:14px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-route-grid h3{font-size:18px}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-final{padding:56px 0}
  #mmdFriendReferralNext .fr-final h2{font-size:clamp(28px,7.6vw,36px)}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #mmdFriendReferralNext *{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important;transform:none!important}
}

/* FINAL MMD CONTRAST SAFETY LAYER — keep last */
#mmdFriendReferralNext :is(h1,h2,h3,.fr-brand-name,.fr-route-grid h3,.fr-steps b,.fr-care-grid b,.fr-faq summary){
  color:var(--ivory)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--ivory)!important;background-image:none!important
}
#mmdFriendReferralNext :is(.fr-kicker,.fr-hero h1 em,h2 em,.fr-inline-link,.fr-text-link){
  color:var(--gold-hi)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--gold-hi)!important

<script id="mmd-friend-referral-v17-js">
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var root=document.getElementById("mmdFriendReferralNext");
  if(!root||root.dataset.ready==="1")return;
  root.dataset.ready="1";

  var params=new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var token=params.get("t");
  if(token){
    root.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/partner"]').forEach(function(link){
      var url=new URL(link.getAttribute("href"),window.location.origin);
      url.searchParams.set("t",token);
      link.href=url.pathname+url.search+url.hash;
    });
  }

  var reduced=window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  root.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(link){
    link.addEventListener("click",function(event){
      var target=root.querySelector(link.getAttribute("href"));
      if(!target)return;
      event.preventDefault();
      target.scrollIntoView({behavior:reduced?"auto":"smooth",block:"start"});
    });
  });

  var reading=root.querySelector(".fr-reading-line");
  function updateProgress(){
    if(!reading)return;
    var doc=document.documentElement;
    var max=Math.max(1,doc.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight);
    root.style.setProperty("--read-progress",Math.min(1,Math.max(0,window.scrollY/max)));
  }
  updateProgress();
  window.addEventListener("scroll",updateProgress,{passive:true});

  var links=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("[data-branch-link]"));
  var sections=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("[data-section]")).filter(function(s){return s.id&&s.id!=="top"});
  if("IntersectionObserver" in window){
    var branchObserver=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(entry){
        if(!entry.isIntersecting)return;
        links.forEach(function(a){a.classList.toggle("is-active",a.getAttribute("href")==="#"+entry.target.id)});
      });
    },{rootMargin:"-28% 0px -58% 0px",threshold:.01});
    sections.forEach(function(section){branchObserver.observe(section)});

    if(!reduced){
      var revealObserver=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
        entries.forEach(function(entry){
          if(!entry.isIntersecting)return;
          entry.target.animate([{opacity:.25,transform:"translateY(14px)"},{opacity:1,transform:"translateY(0)"}],{duration:560,easing:"cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)",fill:"both"});
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        });
      },{threshold:.08});
      root.querySelectorAll(".fr-reveal").forEach(function(node){revealObserver.observe(node)});
    }
  }
})();
</script>
